label: Metric Grim Reaper controls checked
description: The spaced local-pieces and patchwork premises are independent and neither alone excludes a metrically infinite populated past (control 1). Both premises hold, for every register frame, in a populated past that is open below and metrically finite (control 2) and in continuous time with a first moment (control 3), so the metric version excludes neither shape, unlike the coinitial version (which control 2 refutes for every frame) and the unrestricted version (which control 3 refutes for every frame). With silent registers, control 2 also separates spaced from coinitial local pieces individually; for patchwork only the conjunction is separated. Control 2 also shows that the metric conclusion, together with the earlier-grounded possibility premise A3 prime b, does not give possible begun coming-to-be (A3 prime w): a further bridge from metrically finite to begun pasts would be needed. Control 3 shows the premises, the conclusion, begun populated pasts and possible begun coming-to-be together in continuous time. Model claims concern these interpretations only.
